description: Promotion rules and revisit cadence that drive vault evolution. The scan tool evaluates these read-only and proposes candidates; nothing is applied automatically.

rules.name: criterion confirmed by episodes
rules.description: An owner criterion (K1) becomes an explicit criterion when at least two distinct captured sources support it with episodes.
rules.condition: at least two capture notes mention a criterion together with an episode marker (event, job, decision, ceremony)
rules.proposed_action: propose explicit criterion in the matching D/X, owner-confirmed
rules.do_not_apply: single anecdote, unverified figure, or a criterion the owner never stated

rules.name: repeated offer line
rules.description: An offer line that appears in at least two distinct quotes or proposals deserves its own living record.
rules.condition: at least two capture notes contain price or quote markers for the same service line
rules.proposed_action: propose an X01 living offer record
rules.do_not_apply: one-off historical job with no current activity

rules.name: decision with decider and date
rules.description: A direction choice that has a decider and a date is a decision record.
rules.condition: a capture note contains a decision marker and a date token, or an agreement/contract marker
rules.required_evidence: decider plus date (or a written agreement)
rules.do_not_apply: a stated intention with no decider or date

rules.name: closed case with figures
rules.description: An event that has sale, costs and collected amounts all present is ready for a per-event financial analysis.
rules.condition: a capture note contains price markers together with cost markers and payment/balance markers
rules.proposed_action: propose a D05 case analysis with the real result
rules.do_not_apply: partial figures, or a case still open with pending amounts

rules.name: recurring segment or channel
rules.description: A segment or channel that shows up across at least three distinct jobs is a real market position.
rules.condition: at least three capture notes describe distinct jobs or events through the same segment or channel
rules.proposed_action: propose a D02 segment record with episodes
rules.do_not_apply: single mention or a channel the owner never confirmed

rules.name: repeated supplier timing rule
rules.description: A timing rule for suppliers or purchases that repeats across events becomes an operational rule.
rules.condition: at least two capture notes mention supplier or purchase timing (when things must be ordered)
rules.proposed_action: propose a D04 working rule with its episode
rules.do_not_apply: a one-time timing detail with no observed repetition

business_model.suggestion: run the business-model template round or review D01 revisions

market_customers.suggestion: run the market template round or review D02 revisions

offer_commercial.suggestion: run the offer template round or review D03 revisions

execution_processes.suggestion: run the execution template round or review D04 revisions

economy_finance.suggestion: run the economy template round or review the last closed event

people_roles.suggestion: run the people template round after any hire or departure

risks_commitments.suggestion: run the risks template round before high-value events

direction_decisions.suggestion: run the direction template round after each strategic decision
